parent_objective: audit no-update sensitivity probe for contour-aware exact objective
blocked_by: M1636 proves objective sensitivity but blocks repair/update until audit

public_gates: M1637 must audit the M1636 sensitivity result
M1637 must verify base zero residual and perturbed nonzero residual
M1637 must verify no perturbed checkpoint was written
M1637 must decide whether repair/projection design is admitted or whether sensitivity repair is needed
M1637 must keep PPO promotion and private holdout blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat diagnostics as positive targets
do not treat donor_plus_hidden_action as a loss target

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether the exact objective sensitivity probe can support repair/projection design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no actor update, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if base residual is not near zero
stop if perturbations are not detectable
stop if a perturbed checkpoint was written
stop if repair/projection design admission is ambiguous
fallback_plan: admit repair/projection design if sensitivity result is clean
pivot to sensitivity implementation repair if guardrails or residual checks fail
route to branch synthesis if another narrow design would exceed cadence

admission_evidence: M1636 reported public pass and clean guardrails
allowed_updates: M1637 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if audit admits repair/projection design, repair, synthesis, or stop
next_stage_criteria: repair/projection design admission or fallback is explicit
training and PPO remain blocked unless a later design admits them

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1637 audits fixed-tensor objective sensitivity and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audits exact-objective response over correct/wrong hidden branches under controlled policy-output perturbation
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If sensitivity is insufficient, record the blocker and pivot before repair design.
allowed_claims: exact-objective sensitivity audit and route decision
no actor update, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1636 sensitivity result is clean enough to decide whether repair/projection design can be admitted.
success_criteria: M1636 summary and candidate artifacts are audited
audit states supported and unsupported claims
PPO promotion and private holdout remain blocked unless a later design admits them
failure_criteria: audit skips base or perturbed residual checks
audit routes directly to PPO promotion private holdout or actor-input changes
audit claims paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
decision_rule: M1637 passes if it audits the sensitivity result and chooses a safe next route before repair/projection design.
